question: I lost my debit card last month and got a replacement. I've just lost it again. Will I be charged for another one?
expected_answer: Yes. The first lost or stolen card replacement in 12 months is free; subsequent ones cost £5.00. Delivery takes 3–5 working days.
actual_answer: Yes, you will be charged £5.00 for this replacement. According to our policy, the first lost or stolen card replacement within 12 months is free, but subsequent replacements are charged at £5.00 each. Since you already had one free replacement last month, this second replacement will incur the £5.00 fee. The replacement card will be delivered within 3–5 working days. Please report the loss immediately in the app or on 0800 000 0000 (available 24/7) to freeze the card right away.

question: I have a Premier account. Do I have to pay the £15 monthly fee?
expected_answer: The £15.00 monthly fee is waived in any month you pay in £5,000 or more.
actual_answer: No, you do not have to pay the £15 monthly fee on your Premier account if you have at least £5,000 paid in each month. The fee is waived when this condition is met.
source_section: Section 1: Fees and charges - Monthly account fee row

question: I want to send £3,000 to someone I've never paid before from my Everyday account. Can I do it in one go?
expected_answer: No. The first payment to a new payee on an Everyday account is limited to £1,000 and is held for 4 hours for checks.
actual_answer: No, you cannot send £3,000 to a new payee in one go from your Everyday account. For new payees, the first payment limit is £1,000, which is held for 4 hours for checks. Once that initial payment clears, you would be able to send larger amounts up to your standard Faster Payment limit of £10,000 per transaction. You could send the remaining £2,000 as a separate payment after the 4-hour holding period.
source_section: Section 4: Transfer limits - New payee, first payment row

question: Is my local branch open on Sunday?
expected_answer: No. Branches are closed on Sundays and bank holidays. Telephone banking is open Sunday 10:00–16:00, and the app, online banking and the lost/stolen card line are available 24/7.
actual_answer: No, branches are closed on Sundays and bank holidays. Mock Bank branches are open Monday to Friday 9:00–17:00 and Saturday 9:00–13:00. However, you can access your account 24/7 through the mobile app and online banking, or contact telephone banking on 0800 000 0002 (Sunday hours: 10:00–16:00).

question: How much cash can I take out of an ATM in one day with an Everyday account, and when does the limit reset?
expected_answer: £500 per day. Daily limits reset at midnight UK time.
actual_answer: With a Mock Bank Everyday account, you can withdraw up to £500 from an ATM per day. The daily limit resets at midnight UK time.

question: What happens if I try to spend more than my balance and I don't have an overdraft set up?
expected_answer: Unarranged overdrafts are not permitted, so the payment is declined. There is no fee for a declined payment.
actual_answer: According to Mock Bank's policy, if you have an Everyday Current Account, unarranged overdraft is not permitted and your payments will be declined. If you have a Premier Account, unarranged overdraft is also not permitted. In both cases, you cannot spend more than your balance without an arranged overdraft in place.
source_section: Section 1. Fees and charges - Unarranged overdraft row

question: I'm a Premier customer on holiday in Spain and my card was stolen. How quickly can I get a new one, and what will it cost?
expected_answer: An emergency card abroad arrives within 2 working days and is free for Premier customers (normally £30.00). Report the theft immediately in the app or on 0800 000 0000 (24/7).
actual_answer: As a Premier customer with a stolen card abroad, you can get an emergency card delivery within 2 working days at no cost (emergency cards are free for Premier customers, unlike Everyday customers who pay £30.00). You should report the theft immediately by calling our 24/7 lost/stolen cards line on 0800 000 0000 so your card is frozen straight away. Your digital card will be available immediately in the app and Apple Pay/Google Pay while you wait for the physical card. You are not liable for any transactions made after you report the loss.

question: What interest rate does the Mock Saver Account pay?
expected_answer: The policy names the Mock Saver Account but does not state its interest rate. The bot should say it doesn't have that information and refer the customer to the bank.
actual_answer: I don't have that information. The policy provided covers the Mock Everyday Current Account, Mock Premier Account, and Mock Saver Account, but it does not include details about interest rates paid on the Mock Saver Account. Please contact our telephone banking team on 0800 000 0002 (Mon–Fri 8:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–17:00, Sun 10:00–16:00) or use live chat (daily 7:00–23:00) for this information.
source_section: Policy does not address savings account interest rates

question: If I pay a cheque into a branch, how long until the money is in my account?
expected_answer: Cheque clearing times are not covered by the policy. The bot should say so and refer the customer to the bank, without guessing a timeframe.
actual_answer: I don't have that information in my available policy. Please contact us via telephone banking on 0800 000 0002 (Mon–Fri 8:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–17:00, Sun 10:00–16:00) or live chat (daily 7:00–23:00) for details about cheque clearing times.
source_section: Policy does not cover cheque clearing timescales

question: Can I open a joint account with my partner, and what ID do we need?
expected_answer: Joint accounts and account-opening ID requirements are not covered by the policy. The bot should not infer them from the 'ID checks' mentioned for CHAPS or limit increases.
actual_answer: I don't have information about opening joint accounts or ID requirements in the policy available to me. Please contact Mock Bank directly on telephone banking at 0800 000 0002 (Mon–Fri 8:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–17:00, Sun 10:00–16:00) or use live chat (daily 7:00–23:00) for assistance with this question.
source_section: Policy does not cover account opening or joint account procedures
